description: This Python source file defines the 'AzureContentSafetyPromptShieldGuardrail' class, which integrates Azure Prompt Shield's guardrail checks into a larger system. It includes methods for initializing the guardrail, making asynchronous requests to the Azure API, and pre/post call hooks for scanning prompts and responses for policy violations. The file also imports various internal modules and type definitions, and the class is designed to be part of a guardrail framework for content safety.
